description: This Java class, TestContextLoader, extends Spring's AbstractContextLoader to create and manage a web application context that can be refreshed multiple times. It sets up a mock servlet environment for testing purposes, primarily used in testing web modules within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: TestContextLoader
classes.description: Custom context loader for testing Spring web applications, enabling multiple context refreshes with a mock servlet environment.

methods.name: loadContext
methods.description: Creates and returns an XmlWebApplicationContext with specified configuration locations, setting up a mock servlet context.

methods.name: getResourceSuffix
methods.description: Provides the resource suffix used for context configuration files, returning '-context.xml'.

methods.name: loadContext
methods.description: Overloaded method to load application context using MergedContextConfiguration.
